en.summary: Cruz Azul fans celebrated a draw against Pumas at Ciudad Universitaria stadium, sharing memes about the result on social media.

en.title: Puerto Vallarta Airport extends closure of operations until Tuesday due to hurricane
en.summary: Puerto Vallarta Airport extended its operational closure through Tuesday as Hurricane Simon moves slowly and brings intensifying rainfall to the region.

en.title: "Simon, don't overdo it", Puerto Vallarta writes its fears and hopes ahead of the hurricane's arrival; facades fill with messages
en.summary: Residents of Puerto Vallarta expressed their concerns and hopes about Hurricane Simon's arrival through written messages displayed on building facades.

stories.title: Amarga Cruz Azul venganza de Pumas en CU

en.title: Bitter Cruz Azul revenge of Pumas at CU
en.summary: Pumas surrendered a two-goal lead and played with ten men, drawing 3-3 against Cruz Azul at Estadio Olímpico Universitario.

en.title: Cruz Azul frustrates Pumas at CU with dramatic draw; César Huerta sent off
en.summary: Cruz Azul drew with Pumas after the home team surrendered a two-goal lead. César Huerta was expelled during the match.

stories.title: Saldo de 39 detenidos y 28 policías lesionados en manifestación por agua sucia en Jalisco

en.title: 39 detained and 28 police injured in water protest in Jalisco
en.summary: A demonstration over water quality in Jalisco resulted in dozens of arrests and injuries to police officers. State authorities reported 10,000 peaceful participants, with a masked group of around 400 causing violence.

stories.title: Gobierno de Jalisco reporta 39 detenidos tras marcha por agua; hay 59 personas heridas, dice

en.title: Jalisco government reports 39 detained after water march; 59 people injured, it says
en.summary: An official report documented 39 arrests and 59 injured persons following a water crisis protest in Jalisco. The demonstration began peacefully during its initial hours.

stories.title: Deja marcha por agua sucia en Jalisco al menos 12 detenidos

en.title: Water crisis march in Jalisco leaves at least 12 detained
en.summary: A demonstration regarding the water crisis in Guadalajara and surrounding areas resulted in at least 12 arrests and 3 police officers injured.

en.summary: Mexico's president urged residents of coastal municipalities to take shelter as the hurricane approached the region.

en.title: Hurricane Simon has new category: which states remain under threat?
en.summary: Hurricane Simon downgraded from category 4 to 3, but continues producing extraordinary rainfall, intense winds, and waves up to 10 meters high along Mexico's Pacific coast.

stories.title: Huracán Simon se degrada a categoría 3; sigue EN VIVO su trayectoria y afectaciones

en.title: Hurricane Simon downgrades to category 3; its trajectory and impacts tracked live
en.summary: Hurricane Simon remains affecting the coasts of Jalisco and Colima as it continues to be monitored for ongoing impacts.

stories.title: Huracán Simon se acerca a la costa de Jalisco como categoría 4: SMN
